## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; confirmation: mixed sector signal with Energy/Materials/Industrials outperforming while Technology and Healthcare lag (MSFT (1W: -3.91% | 1M: -11.00%) BELOW TREND; UNH (1W: -17.54% | 1M: -11.14%) BELOW TREND), and price leadership concentrated in a handful of names (see Top Performers) producing offsetting signals.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +5.14% | 1M: +16.58%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +6.11% | 1M: +10.98%) ABOVE TREND, EOG (1W: +5.42% | 1M: +8.13%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong: FCX (1W: +10.67% | 1M: +26.83%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials showing support: CAT (1W: +2.60% | 1M: +15.24%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Healthcare weak: UNH (1W: -17.54% | 1M: -11.14%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -5.06%) BELOW TREND. Technology inside mixed-to-lag: MSFT (1W: -3.91% | 1M: -11.00%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -8.16% | 1M: -25.25%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary softer: TSLA (1W: -7.30% | 1M: -9.37%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: META (1W: +14.00% | 1M: +12.09%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +24.63%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.67% | 1M: +26.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +7.07% | 1M: +29.76%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +6.57% | 1M: +2.64%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology), style skewed toward Growth/Momentum among the top names but breadth is mixed.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: PYPL (1W: -7.07% | 1M: -10.72%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -7.30% | 1M: -9.37%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -8.16% | 1M: -25.25%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -8.37% | 1M: -3.73%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -9.20% | 1M: -24.49%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in large-cap tech/fintech names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W momentum: META (1W: +14.00%), TXN (1W: +12.30%), FCX (1W: +10.67%), AMAT (1W: +7.07%), T (1W: +6.57%) — all ABOVE TREND. Major divergences: INTC (1W: -10.42% | 1M: +32.66%) CORRECTION and TMO (1W: -7.40% | 1M: +1.21%) CORRECTION warrant caution as short-term weakness contrasts with longer-term gains.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is mixed-to-lagging on the week despite big winners: META (1W: +14.00% | 1M: +12.09%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +2.28%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +7.87%) ABOVE TREND, while MSFT (1W: -3.91% | 1M: -11.00%) BELOW TREND and NOW (1W: -9.20% | 1M: -24.49%) BELOW TREND signal internal rotation; overall tech breadth is mixed and requires confirmation.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are neutral-to-quiet with idiosyncratic moves: JPM (1W: +0.92% | 1M: -4.93%) RECOVERY, PYPL (1W: -7.07% | 1M: -10.72%) BELOW TREND shows sector dispersion; select banks show resilience but retail/payments remain pressured.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare is under pressure on the week: UNH (1W: -17.54% | 1M: -11.14%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -5.06%) BELOW TREND, while JNJ (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +9.51%) ABOVE TREND is a standout — defensive names mixed with acute idiosyncratic weakness.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Maintain a neutral stance and favor Energy and Materials exposure (XOM (1W: +5.14% | 1M: +16.58%) ABOVE TREND; FCX ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to names showing sustained downside (MSFT BELOW TREND, NOW BELOW TREND, PYPL BELOW TREND). Style: mixed — top-weighted Growth/Momentum names showing strength but market breadth is split, so be selective and monitor major divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: META (1W: +14.00% | 1M: +12.09%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +24.63%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.67% | 1M: +26.83%) ABOVE TREND for momentum follow-through. BEARISH: UNH (1W: -17.54% | 1M: -11.14%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -10.42% | 1M: +32.66%) CORRECTION, NOW (1W: -9.20% | 1M: -24.49%) BELOW TREND for downside risk and trend confirmation.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W +2.76%) and Materials (1W +1.75%) for cyclical strength; Industrials for follow-through. BEARISH: Healthcare (1W -3.02%) and Technology (1W -0.12%) as sources of potential volatility and sector rotation.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA: watch for continuation above recent pivot as ABOVE TREND momentum; AAPL: monitor 1W lift as RECOVERY with 1M down for confirmation; UNH: breach and follow-through on downside to confirm BELOW TREND risk; JPM: short-term RECOVERY needs to hold recent support/resume higher to signal stabilization.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
JNJ (+80): FDA Multiple Myeloma approval — JNJ (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +9.51%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. AMZN (+65): reported potential OpenAI investment — AMZN (1W: +3.15% | 1M: +4.16%) ABOVE TREND, news aligns with price strength. AAPL (+55): strong iPhone quarter — AAPL (1W: +4.00% | 1M: -5.65%) RECOVERY, bullish headlines support the 1W bounce but 1M remains negative.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
UNH (-65): weak 2026 outlook — UNH (1W: -17.54% | 1M: -11.14%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed and a key sector risk. NOW (-50): AI fears for SaaS — NOW (1W: -9.20% | 1M: -24.49%) BELOW TREND, sentiment and price aligned. INTC (-50): competitive hit from Nvidia — INTC (1W: -10.42% | 1M: +32.66%) CORRECTION, news aligns with the 1W drop but 1M strength makes this a divergence to watch.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL; style mixed with Growth/Momentum among leading names but breadth split between cyclical strength and defensive/healthcare weakness. META (1W: +14.00% | 1M: +12.09%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +24.63%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +5.14% | 1M: +16.58%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergences (INTC CORRECTION, UNH BELOW TREND) and mixed sentiment signals warrant watching earnings/guidance and headline-driven moves for confirmation.
